sources.quote:
### Cached prompt is now available

You can now use cached prompt to save on repeated prompts. For
more info, see [models](/developers/models).
sources.supports: xAI documented cached prompts as available in May 2025, before the models.dev field update, but gives no price or precise launch date.

sources.quote: | Model | Context | Input / 1M tokens | Cached input / 1M tokens | Output / 1M tokens |
sources.supports: xAI's current pricing page has a separate cached-input price column; it does not document historical Grok 3 Fast rates.

notes: The provider release notes place cached prompts in May 2025, so their existence predates this models.dev commit, but no supplied or extractable primary source establishes whether these particular cache rates were already official then. The Internet Archive could not be reached (connection refused), so no historical pricing-page snapshot pair was available; classification and effective date remain unclear.
